repos.description: A collective list of free APIs
repos.summary_zh: public-apis 是一个由社区维护的免费 API 集合库，涵盖地理定位、金融、天气、通信等多个领域，提供即用型 RESTful API 接口，支持 Postman 一键调用，助力开发者快速集成第三方数据服务。
repos.summary_en: The public-apis repository is a community-curated collection of free, ready-to-use REST APIs across diverse domains like geolocation, finance, weather, and communication, enabling developers to quickly integrate third-party data services via Postman.

repos.description: :octocat: 分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级的开源项目。Share interesting, entry-level open source projects on GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: HelloGitHub 是一个专注于分享 GitHub 上有趣、入门级开源项目的月刊，每月28日定期发布，涵盖有趣项目、开源书籍、实战及企业级项目。旨在通过精选优质开源内容，帮助用户快速发现开源魅力，激发学习兴趣，降低入门门槛，从而爱上开源生态。
repos.summary_en: HelloGitHub is a monthly publication that curates and shares interesting, beginner-friendly open-source projects from GitHub. Released on the 28th of each month, it features engaging projects, open-source books, practical tutorials, and enterprise-level codebases to help newcomers discover the joy of open source and build real-world skills quickly.

repos.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
repos.summary_zh: gstack 是 Garry Tan（YC 创始人）基于 Claude Code 构建的 AI 工程团队工具集，集成 CEO、设计师、工程师、发布经理等 15 个角色，通过 slash 命令实现产品规划、代码审查、QA 测试、安全审计和自动化部署。支持每日 1-2 万行代码的高效开发，适用于技术型创始人、Claude Code 新手及资深技术负责人。
repos.summary_en: gstack is Garry Tan's (YC President) AI-powered engineering toolkit built on Claude Code, featuring 15 specialized roles including CEO, designer, eng manager, and QA. It enables ultra-high productivity coding through slash commands for planning, review, testing, security audits, and deployment—ideal for technical founders, Claude Code beginners, and senior tech leads.

repos.description: :zap: Dynamically generated stats for your github readmes
repos.summary_zh: GitHub Readme Stats 是一个动态生成 GitHub 统计信息的项目，可自动在个人 README 中展示仓库贡献、语言使用、活跃度等数据，支持高度自定义主题、布局与指标，提升开发者主页展示效果。
repos.summary_en: GitHub Readme Stats dynamically generates GitHub statistics for READMEs, displaying repository contributions, language usage, activity metrics, and more. It supports customizable themes, layouts, and options to enhance developer profile visibility.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: Everything Claude Code 是一个专为 AI 智能体性能优化设计的完整系统，涵盖技能、直觉、记忆、安全和研究优先的开发。它支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cowork 等平台，提供生产级代理、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置，适用于多语言环境，是 Anthropic 黑客马拉松获奖作品。
repos.summary_en: Everything Claude Code is a comprehensive performance optimization system for AI agent harnesses, featuring skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development. It supports Claude Code, Codex, Cowork, and more, offering production-ready agents, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configurations, evolved over 10+ months of real-world use.

repos.description: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
repos.summary_zh: OpenAI Codex CLI 是一款轻量级终端编码智能体，支持本地运行代码生成与编辑。通过 npm 或 Homebrew 一键安装，集成 ChatGPT 账户体系，提供 IDE 插件及桌面应用扩展，适用于开发者快速实现自动化编程任务。
repos.summary_en: Codex CLI is a lightweight coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer. Install via npm or Homebrew, sign in with ChatGPT, and use it in terminal, IDEs like VS Code, or as a desktop app for automated code generation and editing.

repos.description: 在 dsh 里装上这个插件即可，无需登录、注册或填 API Key，就能使用包括 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash、Kimi K3 在内的前沿模型——完全免费，不限量。 All you do is install this plugin in dsh: no login, no sign-up, no API key — the frontier models are just there, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3 among them. Completely free, with no usage cap.
repos.summary_zh: 生成失败
repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: A list of cool features of Git and GitHub.
repos.summary_zh: 本项目是 GitHub 和 Git 的高级功能速查表，涵盖隐藏特性如忽略空白符、分支对比、行号高亮、任务列表、Emoji 支持、Gist 使用、Hub 工具等，帮助开发者提升工作效率，适用于日常开发协作与代码审查场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a comprehensive cheat sheet of advanced Git and GitHub features, including whitespace ignoring, branch comparisons, line highlighting, task lists, emoji support, Gists, Hub CLI, and more—designed to boost developer productivity in collaborative coding and code review workflows.

repos.description: CLI platform to experiment with codegen. Precursor to: https://lovable.dev
repos.summary_zh: gpt-engineer 是一个基于 CLI 的代码生成实验平台，支持通过自然语言描述需求，由 AI 自动生成并执行代码，并可迭代优化。它支持 OpenAI API、本地模型及 Azure 等多种模型，提供项目创建、代码改进和自定义代理基准测试功能，是早期 AI 编程工具的重要探索。
repos.summary_en: gpt-engineer is a CLI platform for experimenting with AI-driven code generation. It allows users to specify software in natural language, watch an AI write and execute code, and iteratively improve it. Supports OpenAI, local models, and Azure, with features for project creation, code improvement, and benchmarking custom agents.

repos.description: The self-driving agent platform
repos.summary_zh: Agno 是一个专为构建、运行和管理大规模智能体软件而设计的运行时框架。它支持构建具备记忆、知识库、防护机制和百种集成的智能体，提供 FastAPI 后端服务，实现状态化智能体的生产级部署与监控，并通过 AgentOS UI 提供测试、管理和追踪功能。
repos.summary_en: Agno is a runtime framework for building, running, and managing agentic software at scale. It enables creation of stateful agents with memory, knowledge, guardrails, and 100+ integrations, serving them via a stateless FastAPI backend in production, with monitoring and management through the AgentOS UI.

repos.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板，通过AI编程代理一键逆向工程任意网站为现代化Next.js代码库。支持Claude Code等主流AI工具，自动提取设计元素、生成组件规范并并行构建页面结构，显著提升前端开发效率。
repos.summary_en: AI Website Cloner Template enables one-command reverse-engineering of any website into a modern Next.js codebase using AI coding agents. It automatically extracts design tokens, generates component specifications, and reconstructs pages through parallel builders, supporting major platforms like Claude Code for rapid frontend development.

repos.description: A Claude Code plugin that automatically captures everything Claude does during your coding sessions, compresses it with AI (using Claude's agent-sdk), and injects relevant context back into future sessions.
repos.summary_zh: Claude-Mem 是专为 Claude Code 设计的持久化记忆压缩系统，通过 AI 自动捕获、压缩编码开发会话中的关键信息，并在后续会话中智能注入相关上下文，显著提升 AI 编程助手的工作记忆效率与连续性。
repos.summary_en: Claude-Mem is a persistent memory compression system for Claude Code that automatically captures, compresses, and injects relevant context from coding sessions using AI, enhancing Claude's working memory and session continuity.

repos.description: The first real AI developer
repos.summary_zh: GPT Pilot 是一款革命性的 AI 开发者工具，旨在通过 LLM 自动生成生产级应用代码，开发者仅需监督与协作。它支持从需求到完整功能的全流程开发，具备调试、对话反馈和代码审查能力，是首个真正意义上的 AI 开发者伴侣。
repos.summary_en: GPT Pilot is an innovative AI developer tool that leverages LLMs to autonomously generate production-ready application code, with developers overseeing and collaborating throughout the process. It supports end-to-end development from requirements to full features, including debugging, interactive feedback, and code review, representing the first true AI developer companion.

repos.description: 410 Claude Code skills & agent skills & plugins (120+ Agents, custom commands, 410+ skills, customizable references, scripts)for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, and 8 more coding agents — engineering, marketing, product, compliance, C-level advisory, research, business operations, commercial & finance, and your daily productivity skills.
repos.summary_zh: Claude Skills & Plugins 是开源的 AI 编码工具增强库，提供205个生产级技能包，覆盖工程、产品、营销、合规及高管咨询等领域。支持11种主流AI开发工具（如Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI），所有Python工具均为stdlib-only，无需额外依赖。通过模块化指令包和CLI脚本实现跨领域专家能力扩展。
repos.summary_en: Claude Skills & Plugins is an open-source library offering 205 production-ready agent skills for 11 AI coding tools, including Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It provides reusable domain expertise in engineering, marketing, compliance, and C-level advisory via modular instruction packages and zero-pip Python tools. All components are cross-platform and tool-agnostic.

repos.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents
repos.summary_zh: Chrome DevTools MCP 是一个专为 AI 编码代理（如 Gemini、Claude、Cursor 等）设计的 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议实现浏览器自动化、性能分析与深度调试。支持网络请求分析、截图、控制台日志追踪及性能追踪，结合 Puppeteer 实现可靠操作，适用于网页自动化与智能调试场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome DevTools MCP is an MCP server enabling AI coding agents (e.g., Gemini, Claude, Cursor) to control and inspect a live Chrome browser via the Chrome DevTools Protocol. It provides advanced debugging, performance tracing, network analysis, and screenshot capabilities using Puppeteer for reliable automation, ideal for web automation and intelligent debugging.

repos.summary_zh: Void 是一款开源的 Cursor 替代 IDE，支持在代码库中使用 AI 智能体、可视化变更与检查点，并允许本地部署任意模型。其核心优势在于直接与 AI 服务商通信而不保留用户数据，基于 VSCode 深度定制，提供高度可定制的 AI 编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Void is an open-source alternative to Cursor, enabling AI agents to work on your codebase with checkpointing, change visualization, and local model hosting. It communicates directly with AI providers without storing your data, built as a VSCode fork with a focus on innovation over feature parity.

repos.description: Resume template for Chinese programmers . 程序员简历模板系列。包括PHP程序员简历模板、iOS程序员简历模板、Android程序员简历模板、Web前端程序员简历模板、Java程序员简历模板、C/C++程序员简历模板、NodeJS程序员简历模板、架构师简历模板以及通用程序员简历模板
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供涵盖PHP、iOS、Android、Web前端、Java、C/C++、NodeJS、架构师等9类程序员岗位的中文简历模板，支持Markdown格式，由AI职业顾问职小兔®优化设计。配套提供在线简历工具冷熊简历与自建版DeerResume，并附《如何写好技术简历》教学资源，助力程序员高效打造专业简历。
repos.summary_en: This repo offers 9 resume templates for Chinese programmers, covering PHP, iOS, Android, Web Frontend, Java, C/C++, NodeJS, and Architect roles in Markdown format, optimized by AI career advisor 职小兔®. It includes tools like Cold Bear Resume and DeerResume, plus teaching resources on writing effective tech resumes to help developers build professional profiles.

repos.description: 互联网首份程序员考公指南，由3位已经进入体制内的前大厂程序员联合献上。
repos.summary_zh: 《程序员考公指南》由三位成功上岸的前大厂程序员联合撰写，总结一年在职备考经验，提供从备考策略、时间管理到岗位选择的系统性指导，帮助程序员转型进入体制内，涵盖公务员、事业编制及教师岗位，强调实用性与可行性。
repos.summary_en: The 'Programmer's Guide to Civil Service Exams' is co-authored by three former tech employees who successfully transitioned into government roles after a year of part-time preparation. It offers practical strategies for programmers considering public sector careers, covering civil service, public institutions, and teaching positions with real-world insights and actionable advice.

repos.description: Maple Mono: Open source monospace font with round corner, ligatures and Nerd-Font icons for IDE and terminal, fine-grained customization options. 带连字和控制台图标的圆角等宽字体，中英文宽度完美2:1，细粒度的自定义选项
repos.summary_zh: Maple Mono 是一款专为提升编码体验而设计的开源等宽字体，具有圆角设计、连字功能及 Nerd-Font 图标支持，适用于 IDE 和终端环境。其特色包括可变字重、智能连字、中英文 2:1 完美对齐，以及细粒度自定义选项，支持简繁中文和日文，适合多语言开发场景。
repos.summary_en: Maple Mono is an open-source monospace font designed to enhance coding flow, featuring rounded corners, ligatures, and Nerd-Font icons for IDEs and terminals. It offers variable font weights, smart ligatures, perfect 2:1 Chinese-English alignment, and extensive customization, supporting Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Japanese for multilingual development environments.

repos.description: flutter 开发者帮助 APP，包含 flutter 常用 140+ 组件的demo 演示与中文文档
repos.summary_zh: FlutterGo 是阿里巴巴推出的 Flutter 开发者辅助应用，提供 140+ 组件的中文文档与演示，帮助开发者快速掌握 Flutter 开发。因团队调整暂停维护，但计划未来迭代并招募社区贡献者。
repos.summary_en: FlutterGo is an Alibaba-developed Flutter developer helper app featuring 140+ component demos and Chinese documentation. It aids developers in mastering Flutter. Due to internal restructuring, maintenance is temporarily paused, with plans for future updates and community contributions.

repos.description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
repos.summary_zh: Roo Code 是一款 VS Code 扩展，将 AI 智能体团队集成到代码编辑器中，支持自然语言生成代码、多模式协作（编码/架构/调试/问答）、自动化任务处理及文档维护，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Roo Code is a VS Code extension that embeds an AI-powered development team directly into your editor. It enables natural language code generation, multi-mode workflows (coding, architecture, debugging, Q&A), automation, and documentation, dramatically boosting developer productivity.

repos.description: 经典编程书籍大全，涵盖：计算机系统与网络、系统架构、算法与数据结构、前端开发、后端开发、移动开发、数据库、测试、项目与团队、程序员职业修炼、求职面试等
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收录100+经典编程书籍，全面覆盖计算机系统与网络、算法与数据结构、前后端开发、数据库、测试、职业修炼等核心领域，精选伯乐在线及社区广泛推荐的权威技术读物，是程序员系统提升技能的理想资源库。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 100+ essential programming books across core domains including computer systems, algorithms, web/mobile development, databases, testing, and career growth. It aggregates highly recommended technical reads from Jobbole and the developer community, serving as a comprehensive learning resource for programmers.

repos.description: :octocat: A collection of APIs
repos.summary_zh: Awesome APIs 是一个精选的 API 集合库，涵盖动漫、博客、书籍、商业、日历、云服务等 40+ 领域，为开发者提供丰富的第三方接口资源，支持快速集成各类功能，提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Awesome APIs is a curated collection of over 40 categories of developer-friendly APIs, including anime, blogging, books, business, cloud services, and more, enabling rapid integration of diverse functionalities and enhancing development efficiency.

repos.description: A faster, simpler way to drive browsers supporting the Chrome DevTools Protocol.
repos.summary_zh: chromedp 是一个高效的 Go 语言库，用于通过 Chrome DevTools 协议驱动浏览器，无需外部依赖。它支持无头模式运行、页面截图、自动化操作等场景，适用于网页爬虫、自动化测试和数据采集。核心优势包括高性能、简洁 API 和跨平台兼容性。
repos.summary_en: chromedp is a high-performance Go library for driving browsers via the Chrome DevTools Protocol without external dependencies. It supports headless browsing, page screenshots, and automation tasks like web scraping and testing. Key features include fast execution, simple API, and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: 超级速查表 - 编程语言、框架和开发工具的速查表，单个文件包含一切你需要知道的东西 :zap:
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是专为开发者设计的中文速查表集合，涵盖编程语言（如 Bash、Python、Go、JavaScript）、开发工具（如 Git、Gdb、Tmux）和文本编辑器（如 Vim、Emacs）的核心语法与命令，每个速查表均为单个文件，便于快速查阅，解决日常开发中频繁查阅文档的问题。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a curated collection of Chinese cheatsheets for developers, covering programming languages (Bash, Python, Go, JavaScript), development tools (Git, Gdb, Tmux), and text editors (Vim, Emacs). Each cheatsheet is a single-file reference for quick lookup, eliminating the need to search scattered documentation.

repos.description: 🚀 Less chaos. More flow.
repos.summary_zh: Noi 是一款以交互为核心的工作流工具，主打‘少些混乱，多些流畅’的理念。它提供多窗口管理、会话隔离、本地数据存储、AI提示词管理、内置终端及跨平台 CLI 控制等功能，旨在提升开发者的专注力与效率，适用于需要并行工作空间和高定制化环境的用户。
repos.summary_en: Noi is an interaction-first workflow tool focused on reducing chaos and enhancing productivity. It features multi-window management, session isolation, local data storage, AI prompt management, built-in terminal, and a cross-platform CLI for integration with tools like Claude Code. Designed for developers seeking streamlined, customizable workflows.

repos.description: 收集整理Android开发所需的Android SDK、开发中用到的工具、Android开发教程、Android设计规范，免费的设计素材等。
repos.summary_zh: AndroidDevTools 是一个专注于 Android 开发的一站式资源平台，提供 Android SDK、开发工具、设计规范、教程及素材的整合。涵盖从开发环境搭建、代码生成、资源处理到设计协作的全流程工具链，支持 Android Studio、Gradle 等主流技术栈，助力开发者高效构建高质量应用。
repos.summary_en: AndroidDevTools is a comprehensive platform for Android developers, offering curated resources including Android SDK, development tools, design guidelines, tutorials, and free assets. It covers the full development lifecycle—from environment setup and code generation to resource optimization and UI design—supporting major tools like Android Studio and Gradle to enhance productivity.

repos.description: Open-source Next.js template for building apps that are fully generated by AI. By E2B.
repos.summary_zh: E2B Fragments 是一个开源的 Next.js 模板，专为构建完全由 AI 生成代码的应用而设计。支持 Python、Next.js、Vue.js、Streamlit 和 Gradio 等开发环境，集成 E2B SDK 安全执行 AI 生成的代码，并兼容 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google AI 等多种大模型提供商，实现流式 UI 交互与 npm/pip 包安装功能。
repos.summary_en: E2B Fragments is an open-source Next.js template for building AI-generated applications. It supports multiple coding environments like Python, Next.js, and Streamlit via the E2B SDK, enabling secure code execution, npm/pip package installation, and streaming UI updates with support for major LLM providers including OpenAI and Anthropic.

repos.description: 【🔞🔞🔞 内含不适合未成年人阅读的图片】基于我擅长的编程、绘画、写作展开的 AI 探索和总结：StableDiffusion 是一种强大的图像生成模型，能够通过对一张图片进行演化来生成新的图片。ChatGPT 是一个基于 Transformer 的语言生成模型，它能够自动为输入的主题生成合适的文章。而 Github Copilot 是一个智能编程助手，能够加速日常编程活动。
repos.summary_zh: 该项目深入探索了基于编程、绘画与写作的AI应用，涵盖StableDiffusion图像生成、ChatGPT文本创作及GitHub Copilot代码辅助。通过Prompt工程实践，系统解析了AI模型在图像描述、文章构思与代码生成中的交互逻辑，并提出了'Prompt编程'概念，探讨自然语言驱动软件开发的可能性。
repos.summary_en: This project explores AI applications in programming, painting, and writing through StableDiffusion image generation, ChatGPT text creation, and GitHub Copilot code assistance. It systematically analyzes how AI models interact with human input via prompt engineering for image description, article structuring, and code generation, proposing the concept of 'prompt programming' as a bridge between natural language and software development.

repos.description: 【编程随想】收藏的开源项目清单
repos.summary_zh: 编程随想维护的开源项目收藏清单，涵盖C/C++和Python两大语言的技术库与示例代码，聚焦程序员实用工具与学习资源，便于快速检索与参考。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of open-source projects by Programthink, featuring code libraries and examples in C/C++ and Python, designed for developers to quickly access practical tools and learning resources.

repos.description: Python QR Code image generator
repos.summary_zh: 纯 Python 编写的 QR 码生成库，支持生成 PNG、SVG 等格式图像，提供命令行工具和 Python API。可自定义尺寸、颜色、纠错等级等参数，适用于快速生成二维码并集成到自动化流程中。
repos.summary_en: A pure Python library for generating QR codes, supporting PNG, SVG, and console output. Offers command-line interface and Python API with customizable parameters like size, colors, and error correction levels, ideal for automation and integration.

repos.description: Multi-agent AI orchestration platform for automation, workflows, and developer tools. Golutra transforms Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw into a unified agent system with parallel execution, task orchestration, long-running workflows, and AI productivity workspace.
repos.summary_zh: golutra 是一款下一代多智能体协作工作台，将现有 CLI 工具转化为统一的 AI 协作枢纽。支持无限并行执行、自动化编排和实时结果跟踪，无需迁移项目或重学命令。基于 Vue 3 + Rust 的 Tauri 桌面应用，兼容 Claude Code、Gemini CLI 等主流 AI 工具，实现‘一人+AI团队’的高效开发模式，适用于软件开发、内容创作等多种场景。
repos.summary_en: golutra is a next-generation multi-agent workspace that transforms existing CLI tools into a unified AI collaboration hub. It supports unlimited parallel execution, automated orchestration, and real-time tracking without project migration or command relearning. Built with Vue 3 + Rust as a Tauri desktop app for Windows, macOS, and Linux, it integrates with AI agents like Claude Code and Gemini CLI to enable efficient 'one person + an AI squad' workflows across software development and content creation.
